_note: What the reader knows about particular sites before it has learned anything itself. A running reader adds what it learns to its own file in the data folder; entries found there worth keeping are copied here so they ship with the reader. Host names only, without a leading www.

front_door._note: Sites that refuse a deep link opened cold but serve it to a visitor coming from inside the site: the reader goes in with the home page as Referer.

local_first._note: Sites a remote reading service (the DeepSeek fetch endpoint) cannot read and this reader can: skip the service.

browser_first._note: Sites whose pages a plain or fingerprinted request does not get (a check page, or an empty page that needs scripts): go straight to the browser. A reader adds a site here after the request tier failed on it and the browser read it.

notes._note: Hints for a model reading a site, given when a question names the site or links to it. names: how people refer to it.

notes: 专辑页（/release/album/艺人/专辑名/）页首写着这张专辑的年度名次和总名次，例如「Ranked #3 for 2005, #185 overall」，还有均分、评分人数、流派和描述词。查某张专辑的名次或评分，直接读它的专辑页，不要去榜单里翻。
专辑页网址一般是小写、空格换成连字符，例如 /release/album/nujabes/modal-soul/。拼不准时先用 search_web 加 site:rateyourmusic.com 找到网址。
榜单（/charts/...）只能读第 1 页，也就是前 40 名，第 2 页起要登录。
短时间内读太多页会被拦（HTTP 503），够回答就停。
